notes.title: v.1.1.0 - Chinese Support & Launch Day
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28004320/06a028a00492e22b3daa9274f41820a87bbe3193.png[/img]

Dear Steam users, whether you use PC, Mac or Linux, this is for you:

Today is the day to rock and roll in the most prehistoric style ever seen as today is the launch of Caveman Warriors! 

And of course, it’s [b]15%[/b] for a limited time. You also have the OST and the Art Book as separate DLCs for the game. If you want to support us a little bit more by purchasing those, you’d put a smile in our cavemen faces.

As part of our final sprint, we’re adding [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]Catalan[/b] to the languages the game will support.

We’d like to that every fan who believed in our dream, every kickstarter pledge, every comment on the internet, every person who told us sincere words during events. Thank you, seriously, thank you all. It may sound like a cliché, but it’s 100% true. 

[i]Without you, there is no Caveman Warriors.[/i]

notes.title: v.1.0.0.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28004320/2f98371c556b6bcd60d5b21ddc847c593ad085ed.png[/img]

[b]Caveman Warriors[/b] will be out on Steam (PC, Mac & Linux) on September 22th, 2017! 

We've been working hard to make this possible and will launch simultaneously on [b]PS4[/b] and [b]Xbox One[/b]. 

If you backed enough to get the beta code, you're already able to play one of our latest builds which includes the entire game, but we'll be working on bug fixing so your experience is even better on its release date. 

Again, thanks to everyone who helped us out on making this a dream come true. That being said... write it down! September 22th is the date for you to free your inner caveman.

notes.title: v0.1.0
notes.notes:
A new version for our Beta testers submitted.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/WXS0iZA.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added Level 5 .
[*] Added sound fx to Level 4.
[*] Added boss teddy bears when killing and hitting multiple time bosses.
[*] Added boss “bonus stage” to the Level 1 boss.
[*] Added Video Options.
[*] Added support to Keyboard and Controller on multiple players (The [*] keyboard should be always the last available player).
[*] Added color to comics.
[*] Updated FMOD to version 1.09.04.
[*] Improved rendering on invisible zones.
[*] Improved some texts translations to Spanish.
[*] Improved attack detection when hitting multiple enemies.
[*] Improved Jack’s axe collision to moving platforms.
[*] Improved Pterodactyl enemy on Level 2 hit boxes.
[*] Fixed bug where Liliana went through platforms when doing the super jump.
[*] Fixed bug where the buttons on the Main Menu didn’t work properly.
[*] Some other minor bug fixes.
[/list]
